mv_filter.comment: Filters on a multi-value column compared to a scalar value. They match a row if any value matches, as in the single-stage engine. They are pushed to the leaf stage, the only stage that can run them.

queries.description: Equality on a STRING MV column
queries.sql: SELECT order_id FROM {orders} WHERE tags = 'urgent' ORDER BY order_id

queries.description: Equality with the value on the left side
queries.sql: SELECT order_id FROM {orders} WHERE 'vip' = tags ORDER BY order_id

queries.description: IN on a STRING MV column
queries.sql: SELECT order_id FROM {orders} WHERE tags IN ('vip', 'normal') ORDER BY order_id

queries.description: IN with a large value list on a STRING MV column
Two equalities on the same MV column are not folded to false
queries.sql: SELECT order_id FROM {orders} WHERE tags = 'urgent' AND tags = 'vip' ORDER BY order_id

queries.description: Equality and IN on an INT MV column
queries.sql: SELECT order_id FROM {orders} WHERE codes = 5 OR codes IN (1, 3) ORDER BY order_id

queries.description: MV equality pushed below a join
queries.sql: SELECT o.order_id, c.name FROM {orders} o JOIN {customers} c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.tags = 'urgent' ORDER BY o.order_id

queries.description: MV IN pushed below a join with an aggregate above it
queries.sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(*) FROM {orders} o JOIN {customers} c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.tags IN ('vip', 'normal') GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY c.name

queries.description: MV filter that cannot be pushed to the leaf stage
queries.sql: SELECT order_id FROM (SELECT order_id, tags FROM {orders} ORDER BY order_id LIMIT 10) t WHERE t.tags = 'urgent'

queries.description: MV filter in a disjunction across both sides of a join
queries.sql: SELECT o.order_id FROM {orders} o JOIN {customers} c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.tags IN ('vip', 'normal') OR c.name = 'Alice'
